descriptions.job-0rm0lsf:
At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs. 

If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.

THE WORK:

At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs.

Ripple is growing, and we're looking to hire an experienced Senior Sales Manager, based in London to cover the UK/Europe market. This sales quota-carrying position is responsible for revenue generation through the direct sale of Ripple Custody to financial institutions, crypto natives and FinTechs. The ideal candidate lives and breathes customer centricity, is a sales hunter and has a passion for the digital asset industry.

If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.

WHAT YOU’LL DO: 

  • Demonstrate extensive knowledge of Ripple products, including Custody, Stablecoin and Payments, effectively communicating the value propositions to Financial Institutions and Crypto-Natives.
  • Generate leads and secure sales bookings for Ripple products in London to achieve assigned sales quotas.
  • Develop strategic plans and account tactics, guided by management, to nurture leads and foster relationships within assigned territories and accounts.
  • Conduct client site visits, deliver sales presentations, and perform product demonstrations to prospective clients, driving engagement and interest.
  • Facilitate the smooth progression of leads through the sales process, including prospect qualification, needs assessment, solution presentation, and timely closure of deals.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date sales pipeline forecasts daily, ensuring timely and detailed reporting of sales activities and outcomes.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING: 

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred
  • 8+ years experience in a consultative sales role in technology and/or Financial Services industry.
  • 3+ years of experience in the Digital Assets and/or payments industry or a related field.
  • Must have a proven track record of successful sales to Financial Insitutions and Crypto-Natives
  • Extensive relationships and strong knowledge within the Financial Services and Digital Asset industry in Europe
  • Ability and desire to manage a territory independently
  • Additional language skills advantageous.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and a proactive, collaborative approach.
  • Strong knowledge of Salesforce and other relevant industry tools.

WHO WE ARE:

Do Your Best Work

  • The opportunity to build in a fast-paced start-up environment with experienced industry leaders
  • A learning environment where you can dive deep into the latest technologies and make an impact.  A professional development budget to support other modes of learning.
  • Thrive in an environment where no matter what race, ethnicity, gender, origin, or culture they identify with, every employee is a respected, valued, and empowered part of the team.
  • In-office collaboration for moments that matter is important to our culture, and we give managers and teams the flexibility to decide which 10+ days a month they come in. 
  • Bi-weekly all-company meeting - business updates and ask me anything style discussion with our Leadership Team
  • We come together for moments that matter which include team offsites, team bonding activities, happy hours and more!

Take Control of Your Finances

  • Competitive salary, bonuses, and equity
  • Competitive benefits that cover physical and mental healthcare, retirement, family forming, and family support
  • Employee giving match
  • Mobile phone stipend

Take Care of Yourself

  • R&R days so you can rest and recharge
  • Generous wellness reimbursement and weekly onsite & virtual programming
  • Generous vacation policy - work with your manager to take time off when you need it
  • Industry-leading parental leave policies. Family planning benefits.
  • Catered lunches, fully-stocked kitchens with premium snacks/beverages, and plenty of fun events

Benefits listed above are for full-time employees. 

Ripple is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We do not discriminate against qualified employees or applicants because of race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, sexual identity, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, marital status, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, military status, or any other characteristic protected by local law or ordinance.

descriptions.job-12nu3m7:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Partner Marketing team extends Stripe’s marketing reach to customers and prospects by educating, engaging and enabling partners, globally, to build market awareness and generate demand for their Stripe solutions and services. We recruit prospective partners and support the on-boarding and growth of existing partners as they build, launch, market, and scale business through the Stripe Partner Ecosystem and the Stripe platform. We partner closely with our global partnerships, GTM partners, marketing, and product teams and serve many different partner types.

What you’ll do

We’re looking for an experienced, strategic, and results-oriented marketing leader to own Stripe’s global partner marketing strategy for Services partners—including GSIs—and Technology/ISV partners. You’ll lead a global team, define the multi-year operating and investment model, build influential relationships with partner and Stripe leaders, and scale programs that drive partner-sourced and partner-attached pipeline, customer activation, and product adoption. This role requires setting a clear long-term direction while leading through others and using performance insights to focus the organization on its highest-impact opportunities.

Responsibilities

  • Set the multi-year vision and global strategy for Services, GSI, and Technology/ISV partner marketing, translating Stripe’s company, marketing, and partnerships priorities into an operating model, investment strategy, and measurable outcomes.
  • Lead and develop a high-performing global team of four Partner Marketing professionals across APAC, AMER, and EMEA. Establish clear accountability, build organizational capability, evolve the team as business needs change, and ensure agencies and vendors extend the team effectively.
  • Build trusted relationships with partner CMOs and senior Stripe leaders. Develop joint strategies with priority partners and align global and regional teams around shared priorities, investments, and execution.
  • Own a portfolio of differentiated programs for strategic partners and scalable programs for the broader ecosystem. Integrate partners into Stripe campaigns, regional initiatives, co-sell motions, events, content, and enablement to drive pipeline, activation, and product adoption.
  • Shape joint value propositions, messaging, and customer evidence, and turn successful programs into reusable playbooks that can scale across partners and regions.
  • Establish governance for market development funds and other investments, alongside the performance framework, dashboards, and business-review cadence. Use data and financial insight to assess impact, address underperformance, and reallocate resources toward the strongest opportunities.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 15+ years of relevant B2B marketing experience, including substantial experience in partner, ecosystem, channel, or alliances marketing and a strong understanding of partner business models and indirect GTM motions.
  • A track record of setting and leading global marketing strategy across regions, translating company priorities into long-term plans, scalable operating models, and measurable business outcomes.
  • Experience building, leading, and developing a distributed team of experienced marketers, including setting direction and accountability, coaching talent, and evolving organizational capabilities through change.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives with a high degree of autonomy, build trusted relationships with partner and internal executives, and align senior stakeholders without relying on direct authority.
  • Proven success delivering measurable partner-marketing outcomes and using analytical and financial judgment to manage significant budgets or market development funds, evaluate ROI, and make portfolio trade-offs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the judgment to simplify complex issues, articulate a compelling vision, and turn strategy and performance insights into clear executive recommendations and action.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience developing marketing strategies for Services, GSI, Technology, or ISV partners in a global, high-growth technology environment.
  • Experience in payments, financial technology, enterprise software, or an adjacent industry.
  • Breadth across partner marketing and adjacent disciplines such as demand generation, product marketing, field marketing, or integrated campaigns.
  • Experience managing agencies or vendors across markets and holding them accountable for quality and results.
descriptions.job-0zl405r:
Driving the next generation of wealth.

Digital assets are redefining how wealth is created, used, and transferred. Since 2018 at Nexo, we have been building the future model of financial wealth - dynamic, accessible, and designed for a new generation of forward-thinking investors.

But technology alone doesn’t drive progress. People do.

We are a team of builders, strategists, analysts, creatives, and operators united by a shared mindset: advancement. We move fast, think long term, and take ownership. We challenge ideas, not people. We value clarity over noise and impact over optics.

What makes Nexo different?

We shape industry trends. We rethink how wealth works and build solutions that reflect that belief.

That requires a certain kind of person.

You will thrive here when you think independently and act decisively, take ownership without waiting for permission, and care deeply about quality, long-term value, and disciplined execution. The people who succeed at Nexo bring analytical depth, sound judgment, and resilience - but also curiosity and the drive to keep improving.

This is an environment for people who want to lead, create, and elevate what already exists. If building what’s next excites you, you’ll feel at home at Nexo.

Official website: nexo.com

Your role:

  • Collaborate with data analysts & stakeholders to understand in-depth the business requirements, design expected outcomes and user stories.
  • Gather, integrate, and clean up data from various Nexo-based and external sources.
  • Implement statistical and/or machine learning models to drive actionable insights.
  • Automate existing models to run on a daily, weekly, monthly basis.
  • Monitor and improve data and model quality.
  • Visualize model results, integrate with Tableau dashboards & extract business insights.
  • Discover and employ meanignful AI-driven optimizations in your day-to-day tasks.
  • Partner with cross-area teams to support self-service data initiatives.

What makes you stand out:

  • 3+ years experience as Data Scientist.
  • Theoretical knowledge of common statistical and machine learning algorithms - e.g. predictive, clustering, classification, optimization algorithms.
  • Proven ability for practical application of such models to solve business problems - e.g. forecasting, customer segmentation, customer engagement, driver impact analysis.
  • Experience in exploring, integrating, and modelling massive data sets (100+ million of rows with dozens of variables).
  • Proficiency in SQL, Python, PySpark.
  • Reporting and Data Visualization skills will be considered a plus.
  • Working experience with AWS solutions will be considered a plus.
  • Working experience with APIs will be considered a plus.
  • Experience in finance, banking and/or crypto will be considered a plus.
  • Experience with NLP techniques, analyzing and classifying large amounts of text data will be considered a plus.

Nexo benefits:

  • Competitive and rewarding remuneration package.
  • Annual performance-based bonuses.
  • Comprehensive Learning Hub for continuous growth.
  • Hybrid work model: primarily office-based with scheduled home office flexibility.
  • A dynamic and inspiring environment with cutting-edge projects.
  • Career development opportunities in a global leader driving the next generation of wealth.
  • Customizable personal benefits package.
  • Wellness benefits include additional health insurance, all-access sports cards, team-wide sports activities, standing desks, and blue light glasses.
  • Parking and public transportation cards at preferential rates, plus free electric bikes.
  • Fresh fruits, snacks, and a well-stocked office kitchen.
  • Regular department team buildings and company-wide team buildings.

About the Company

Born from groundbreaking research at Columbia University and Yale University, CertiK is a leading Web3 security company focused on securing blockchain protocols, smart contracts, and decentralized applications through cutting-edge security research, formal verification, and AI-powered technology. Founded in 2017 and headquartered in New York City, CertiK provides end-to-end security solutions including smart contract audits, penetration testing, on-chain monitoring, incident response, and compliance services for some of the largest projects in the digital asset ecosystem.

Today, CertiK supports thousands of enterprise clients and Web3 projects globally, with a distributed international team spanning North America, Asia, and Europe. The company is backed by leading investors including Coatue, Goldman Sachs, Insight Partners, and Sequoia Capital, and has been recognized by organizations such as the World Economic Forum and CB Insights for its contributions to blockchain security innovation.

About the role

CertiK works with banks, regulators and regulated financial institutions that adopt digital assets. We build regulatory technology for these markets, and we are hiring a lead product manager to own what we build next for these clients.

You will gather client needs directly and through our client-facing consultants, turn them into a clear, prioritized roadmap, and present our products to clients, prospects and regulators in North America and, when needed, abroad. Inside the company, you represent the customer.

descriptions.job-1gwt2mn:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Mobile Development Productivity team makes building, testing, and releasing Stripe’s mobile applications and device-integrated software fast, reliable, and secure. The team owns the mobile development platform end to end, including development environments, simulators and emulators, continuous integration, automated testing, builds, and releases. We support engineers working across iOS, Android, React Native, Kotlin Multiplatform, mobile SDKs, and device-integrated software.

Our customers include engineers working on Stripe Dashboard Mobile, Link, Stripe’s mobile SDKs, and Terminal. We enable mobile engineers to use AI agents throughout the development process, including writing code, running tests, and validating changes across mobile platforms. Our work reduces manual release effort, improves test coverage, and makes mobile development faster and more reliable.

What you’ll do

You will lead the Mobile Development Productivity engineering team and set the technical strategy for the platform Stripe engineers use to build mobile applications and device-integrated software. You will work with engineers and leaders across mobile product and infrastructure teams to identify shared development challenges, align priorities, and translate a long-term technical vision into focused plans for your team.

You will grow and support a team that builds development environments, continuous integration systems, test infrastructure, and secure build and release workflows. You will also guide the team’s work to make AI agents effective participants in mobile development by giving them realistic environments, tools, and feedback for validating changes across mobile platforms.

Responsibilities

  • Lead, support, and grow a team of engineers by hiring, coaching, mentoring, and creating opportunities for development
  • Define the team’s technical strategy, goals, and roadmap, translating organizational priorities and internal user needs into clear execution plans
  • Partner with mobile product teams, infrastructure teams, and technical leaders to identify shared development challenges and align stakeholders around reusable solutions
  • Collaborate with staff engineers on architecture and strategic technical decisions across development environments, continuous integration, automated testing, and secure build and release systems
  • Establish high standards for reliability, security, engineering craft, and operational rigor across the systems the team owns
  • Improve the experience of mobile engineers and AI agents by using measures of developer productivity, build and test performance, and release health to guide investments
  • Work effectively with geographically distributed colleagues to maintain alignment, visibility, and clear ownership across teams

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 8+ years of software development experience, including 3+ years of engineering management experience
  • Experience leading teams that build platforms, frameworks, infrastructure, or tools used by other engineers
  • Demonstrated ability to define technical strategy, guide architecture decisions, and translate ambiguous goals into a clear roadmap and execution plan
  • Proven success hiring, coaching, and developing engineers while fostering an inclusive, challenging, and supportive work environment
  • Ability to align and influence cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority, communicate clearly across varied audiences, and coordinate difficult decisions and tradeoffs

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience managing a developer productivity, developer platform, mobile infrastructure, or internal tools team
  • Experience building or operating development environments, continuous integration systems, automated testing frameworks, or build and release infrastructure
  • Experience with iOS, Android, React Native, Kotlin Multiplatform, mobile SDKs, or device-integrated software
descriptions.job-05gzurz:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

We are seeking an exceptional VP of Tech Expansion to lead the global adoption and commercial expansion of Tether’s technology ecosystem.

Reporting directly to the Chief Expansion Officer, this executive will oversee the expansion of current and future technologies across areas such as artificial intelligence, self-custodial infrastructure, peer-to-peer systems, and digital & financial infrastructure.

The VP will lead several senior professionals globally and teams responsible for expanding Tether’s different technology verticals, ensuring a coordinated global strategy and compelling propositions for major companies, institutions, and governments.

The VP will own the talent agenda for international expansion: recruiting, developing and motivating team members, and deepening the existing bench of global leaders across verticals.

This is a senior, hands-on leadership role requiring strong technology understanding, commercial judgment, executive presence, and global relationship-building capabilities. The ideal candidate can engage with CEOs, CTOs, CIOs, and government leaders, translate complex needs into technology solutions, and convert opportunities into major partnerships and deployments.

Equally important, the VP will turn these engagements into replicable, scalable products and playbooks, so that each deployment strengthens Tether's ability to enter the next market rather than remaining a one-off.

International travel is required.

Responsibilities

Global Strategy & Business Development

  • Define and execute the global expansion strategy for Tether’s technology ecosystem.

  • Establish priorities across current and future technology verticals.

  • Identify high-potential markets, industries, partners, and use cases.

  • Build relationships with CEOs, CTOs, CIOs, government leaders, and other senior stakeholders.

  • Personally originate, structure, negotiate, and close major partnerships and deployments.

  • Position Tether as a long-term technology and infrastructure partner.

Solutions & Execution

  • Connect Tether’s different capabilities to develop tailored and integrated solutions.

  • Translate market and partner requirements into clear opportunities for product and engineering teams.

  • Coordinate internal stakeholders and external implementation partners from initial concept through deployment and scale.

  • Ensure major projects are delivered on time, within budget, and against measurable objectives.

  • Monitor solutionss performance, identify risks, and develop mitigation plans.

Leadership

  • Lead the senior professionals and teams responsible for expanding Tether’s different technologies.

  • Set clear priorities, KPIs, and accountability / monitoring frameworks.

  • Build a high-performing global Tech Expansion organization.

  • Ensure effective collaboration with regional Expansion, product, engineering, legal, and regulatory teams.

  • Develop repeatable commercial and execution playbooks across technologies and markets.

  • Identify issues requiring escalation and bring them to the Chief Expansion Officer with clear context and recommended options.

Strategic Representation

  • Position Tether as a global leader in decentralized AI, resilient financial infrastructures, and user-centred technologies.

  • Represent Tether in strategic engagements with major enterprises, institutions, governments, regulators, and industry leaders.

  • Act as a senior ambassador for Tether’s technology vision at global conferences, industry forums and in front of global companies senior executives

  • 12+ years of experience across enterprise technology, AI, digital infrastructure, fintech and digital assets, telecommunications, or technology business development, including senior leadership experience.

  • Strong understanding of emerging technologies, decentralized infrastructure, and digital platforms.

  • Proven experience originating, structuring, and closing major enterprise or government technology partnerships.

  • Ability to engage credibly with C-suite executives, government leaders, and other senior decision-makers.

  • Experience developing global go-to-market strategies across multiple technologies and markets. Strong leadership experience, including managing senior professionals and international teams.

  • Exceptional communication, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills.

  • Ability to coordinate commercial, product, engineering, legal, regulatory, and implementation teams.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset and ability to operate effectively in fast-moving environments.

  • Degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, AI, or a related field, combining strong business expertise with a solid technology foundation; MBA preferred.

  • Experience working across multiple regions and cultures.

  • An established global network across major enterprises, technology companies, financial institutions, and governments.

Nice to Have: Professional proficiency in three or more languages.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

This is a player-coach role: you will operate at executive level while remaining technically close enough to review PRs, guide data modeling and pipeline design, and challenge analytical conclusions.

We are looking for a hands-on VP, Product Analytics to lead Product Analytics and build an AI-native analytics operating system across the company’s crypto, stocks, prediction markets, perpetuals, and stock futures products.

You will set the analytics strategy, lead and develop the Product Analytics team, and ensure data consistently shapes product and business decisions. Lead Product Analytics

Own product and business reporting

descriptions.job-1b4fkzz:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. More than 10 million businesses build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.6% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. Our own growth is wholly contingent on the success of the businesses building on Stripe. We therefore invest back into our technology at an unusual rate. We make upgrades to our products every single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the most reliable APIs on the internet. We build entirely new pieces of financial infrastructure to enable new ideas. And our significant advances in risk and fraud infrastructure over many years are making the internet economy safer and more accessible.

Though people at Stripe don’t tend to take themselves seriously, Stripe is a fairly serious place: our customers are depending on us for their livelihoods. We admire ambition, intensity, curiosity, humility, and rigor. The most effective people become knowledgeable about many domains besides their own. Any company is an applied exercise in understanding some aspect of society or the market. In working with so many (especially the new and innovative ones), we think that Stripe is one of the very best places to learn about how the world works.

 

About the team

Our Data Science team partners deeply with teams across Stripe to ensure that our users, our products, and our business have the models, data products, and insights needed to make decisions and grow responsibly. We're looking for data scientists with a passion for analyzing data, building machine learning and statistical models, and running experiments to drive impact. Our Fraud, Losses, and Financial Crime Data Science team builds the models and data products that protect Stripe and its users from fraud, account takeover, and financial crime. We own the full fraud and loss modeling stack - from account takeover detection and card fraud classification to merchant-level loss estimation, unsupervised anomaly detection, and financial crime risk modeling. We partner with Fraud Engineering, Financial Crimes Engineering, and Risk Operations to bring these systems into production and ensure they have measurable impact on Stripe's financial integrity and user trust.

 

What you’ll do

As an intern at Stripe you’ll work on projects across our stack that directly impact the way millions of businesses operate. You’ll own problems end to end with the support of your manager and teammates. It’s an opportunity to work alongside some of the most creative and technically rigorous data analysts and scientists in the industry. You'll partner deeply with teams across Stripe to ensure that our users, our products, and our business have the models, data products, and insights needed to make decisions and grow responsibly. You'll work closely with partners to extract insights from the rich and complex data at Stripe. You'll build metrics, scalable data pipelines, dashboards, and reports to inform and run the business. You'll deliver actionable business recommendations through analyses and data storytelling.

Our internship program is competitive and the expectations are high.

Responsibilities

  • Applying probability distributions, statistical inference, and hypothesis testing to quantify uncertainty and evaluate business outcomes
  • Using Python or R for data analysis, data processing, visualizations, statistical modeling, machine learning, predictive analytics, automation, and implementing causal inference and experimental analyses
  • Building, training, and evaluating predictive models across regression and classification tasks for bias-variance trade-offs and model selection
  • Modeling temporal dependencies, seasonality, and trend decomposition to generate and evaluate time-series predictions
  • Identifying structural patterns, clusters, and outliers in unlabeled data
  • Deploying models in production and adjusting model thresholds to improve performance
  • Designing, running, and analyzing complex experiments and leveraging causal inference designs
  • Using SQL and Spark to create, transform, and analyze large datasets
  • Learn quickly by asking great questions, finding how to work with your mentor and teammates effectively, and communicating the status of your work clearly
  • Present your work to the Data Science team, partner teams, and fellow interns.

Who you are

  • Ambitious builder: You’re energized by building solutions without clear precedent and solving problems with far-reaching consequences. Successful Stripes are deeply curious, and prefer the joy of discovery to the comfort of certainty.
  • Rigorous thinker: You appreciate that things worth doing are rarely simple. You enjoy working on problems that have never been tackled before.
  • Adaptable problem solver: You adapt quickly and treat obstacles as opportunities. At Stripe we embrace kindness while encouraging Stripes to take measured risks and act boldly, even in the absence of consensus.

 

Minimum requirements

  • Enrolled in a quantitative PhD program (e.g. Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, etc.) with the expectation of graduating in December 2027 or spring/summer 2028
  • Experience with SQL and a scientific computing language (such as Python, R, etc.)
  • Proficiency with AI tools to accelerate model development, analysis, and coding
  • Experience communicating and collaborating with multidisciplinary stakeholders in a team environment 

 

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience writing and debugging data pipelines
  • Demonstrated ability to evaluate and receive feedback from mentors, peers, and stakeholders via experience from previous internships or other multi-person projects
  • Ability to learn new systems and form an understanding of those systems, through independent research and working with a mentor and subject matter experts
descriptions.job-1tdv3nz:
ABOUT THE ROLE

The Mechanical Systems Expert is Managed Services' expert embedded in a data center build - supporting design review and commissioning to ensure cooling systems are operable and maintainable at turnover. Every design decision eventually becomes someone's 3 a.m. problem; this role reviews the design and witnesses the testing on behalf of that person.


Some of the key responsibilities you should expect are the following:

Operability Design Review

Review mechanical and cooling designs - chilled water plants, air and liquid cooling systems, CDUs, CRAHs, heat rejection, water treatment - through an operations lens: maintenance access and laydown, isolation and redundancy behavior, degraded-mode operation, instrumentation adequacy, and failure-mode consequences. File review comments that change designs, not just document concerns.

Construction-Phase Verification

Walk mechanical installations at key milestones: pipe routing and support, valve access, equipment clearances, insulation quality, and cleanliness/flushing protocol compliance - catching operability problems while they're still cheap to fix.

Commissioning Witness

Witness Level 3-5 commissioning of mechanical systems: functional performance tests, staging and failover sequences, failure scenarios, and integrated systems testing. Drive operational issues into the Cx log with clear acceptance criteria and verify closure personally.

Turnover Readiness

Verify mechanical turnover packages: O&Ms, as-builts, valve tags and system labeling, water treatment baselines, spare parts and consumables lists, and PM program inputs (frequencies, procedures, vendor contacts). Validate training actually equips operators to run the plant.

Operations Transition Support

Support early operations stabilization post-turnover: alarm tuning input, setpoint refinement, and first-months troubleshooting alongside the operations team.

Program Feedback

Feed operational lessons into Hut 8 mechanical design standards and the next project's basis of design.

ABOUT YOU

What we're looking for:

  • 8+ years in critical facilities mechanical operations, commissioning, or chief-engineer-track roles.
  • Deep hands-on knowledge of chilled water plants, hydronic systems, and data center cooling topologies - air-cooled, water-cooled, and liquid/direct-to-chip.
  • Level 1-5 commissioning fluency from the witness/operations side, including integrated systems testing.
  • Sharp eye for maintainability in design reviews: access, isolation, and instrumentation gaps.
  • Turnover documentation rigor - you read the O&M before signing for it.
  • Comfortable embedded with a construction team while holding the operations line.
  • Water treatment and cleanliness protocol experience for critical hydronic systems.
  • CFC/EPA certifications, trade licensure, or engineering degree all welcome paths.

ABOUT THE WORK ENVIRONMENT

  • Full time on-site role.

We work alongside Stripe’s Core Sales and Customer Success teams to help users adopt products that improve payment experiences, increase conversion, support international growth, and create new sources of revenue.

We are hiring an Account Executive, Product - Local Payment Methods to grow adoption of Stripe’s local payment methods across EMEA. This role will work across Stripe’s global LPM portfolio while developing particular expertise in the payment preferences, market dynamics, and user opportunities most relevant to Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. The role will initially emphasize Stripe’s largest European markets and the markets where local payment preferences are most pronounced—including the UK and Ireland, DACH and Switzerland, Benelux, the Nordics, Southern Europe, and selected Central and Eastern European markets—while supporting priority growth opportunities in the Middle East and Africa.

You will partner with Core Account Executives and Customer Success Managers throughout the sales cycle—from opportunity identification and discovery through business-case development, commercial negotiation, technical validation, implementation, activation, and expansion.

You will help some of Stripe’s largest and most sophisticated users understand how regionally relevant payment methods can support conversion, customer choice, global expansion, and sustainable revenue growth for users and payment-method partners. You will develop deep knowledge of Stripe’s portfolio and the payment behaviors that shape commerce across EMEA, including bank-based payment methods, wallets, and other country-specific payment experiences.

You are an adept salesperson who can engage in business and technical conversations at multiple levels of an organization. You are comfortable navigating product-led integrations and complex customer structures, and you can turn payment-method complexity into a clear commercial and technical path forward. You enjoy building value in competitive situations and creating scalable go-to-market motions from what you learn in the field.

  • Deliver against an individual quota by driving adoption, payment volume, and revenue for Stripe’s local payment methods across EMEA.

  • Build territory and account strategies that reflect local payment preferences and user expansion priorities across the UK and Ireland, DACH and Switzerland, Benelux, the Nordics, Southern Europe, selected Central and Eastern European markets, and priority opportunities in the Middle East and Africa.
  • Lead discovery with business, product, finance, and technical stakeholders to understand customer needs and recommend appropriate payment-method strategies.
  • Develop customer-specific business cases that connect LPM adoption to conversion, customer choice, market entry, and revenue growth.

  • Work with Solutions Architecture, Product, Engineering, and Post-Sales teams to translate user requirements into viable integration and launch plans.
  • Guide users from initial evaluation through technical validation, implementation, activation, and post-launch expansion.
  • Monitor adoption and payment volume after launch, identify barriers and whitespace, and coordinate with account teams on growth plans.
  • Serve as an internal and customer-facing LPM expert, creating field enablement, account-planning guidance, and repeatable regional sales plays.
  • Synthesize market intelligence and user feedback for Product, Engineering, Partnerships, and Marketing to help inform product and go-to-market priorities.

  • 5+ years of experience in sales, business development, partnerships, or a closely related commercial role at a technology company, with a track record of strong performance against goals.
  • Experience leading complex B2B sales cycles involving multiple business, commercial, and technical stakeholders.

  • Strong executive presence and the ability to communicate effectively with product and engineering teams, operational leaders, and C-level executives.

  • A self-starting, highly organized approach and the ability to deliver results in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment.

descriptions.job-107drnz:
About the Company

Rain is the global stablecoin payments platform for enterprises, neobanks, platforms, developers, and AI agents. Our technology allows partners to move, store, and use stablecoins instantly and compliantly through global payment cards, rewards, on/offramps, wallets, and cross-border rails. As both a Visa and Mastercard Principal Member, Rain issues cards that work at more than 175 million merchant locations in over 220 countries and territories. Built natively for stablecoins and trusted by more than 100 organizations worldwide, Rain delivers secure, scalable infrastructure that makes money move freely and instantly around the world.

You will have the opportunity to deliver massive impact at a hypergrowth company backed by some of the top investors in fintech, crypto, and SaaS. In January 2026, we closed a $250M Series C led by ICONIQ, valuing Rain at $1.95B, with Sapphire Ventures, Norwest, Galaxy Ventures, Dragonfly, Bessemer Venture Partners, FirstMark, Lightspeed, and Endeavor Catalyst also participating. If you're curious, bold, and excited to help shape a borderless financial future, we'd love to talk.

Our Ethos

We believe in an open and flat structure. You will be able to grow into the role that most aligns with your goals. Our team members at all levels have the freedom to explore ideas and impact the roadmap and vision of our company.

Rain operates around the world and services global businesses and platforms with embedded financial products and services. We work with some of the biggest businesses in the world and serving them means servicing their end users around the world. Getting there usually means expanding our licensing coverage either through direct force projection or through strategic partnerships. Once we’re in a market this work transitions to getting our products and services up and running to ship local products.

Market Expansion is a high impact, small, SWAT-like team that owns launching local financial products in each of our target geographies. We like to work in person and we work on every market Rain decides to enter. As part of this team, you will go exotic places, meet exotic people, and build exciting products.

The team is, by definition, heavily cross functional requiring team members to work with Product, Legal, Compliance, and Go To Market.

We are accountable for the outcome, not for the project plan. The model is deliberately temporary in each market. A launcher deploys into a market, launches the product, hires and hands over to a local GM, and moves to the next one.

A market launch is a complex project that runs 3 to 12 months, touches around twelve cross functional capabilities and more than ten internal functions.

If you want a clean, independent role inside one function, this is not for you. If you want to be personally accountable for making an impact on one of the fastest growing financial technology companies, keep reading.

What you’ll do

  • Be Global: Spend significant time, in person, in each market you launch.

  • Be Autonomous: Own a market launch end to end, from the point the entry decision is made to the point the business runs without you.

  • Operate Across the Company: Work with our legal team to manage the local regulatory and legal processes for licence expansion or transfer where we go direct.

  • Define and execute the operationalization strategy for each market, meaning the specific decisions about how Rain's technology, team and systems get deployed in the local market.

  • Identify and solve blockers to quick market launch.

  • Coordinate and drive a 100 day plan for each market, including the workstream owners, the sequencing, the reporting cadence, and the escalation path when a workstream slips.

  • Identify and hire the key local roles, usually a country lead and their first two or three hires, and ramp them up / coach them through the first few weeks at their roles.

  • Detect what is missing before it becomes a problem. Additional licences, gaps and remediations that nobody has scoped.

  • Own and improve the playbook.

You are likely to succeed if you have:

  • Background: roughly 5 to 7 years of experience in strategy consulting, private equity operations, or an operating role in a regulated fintech or payments business.

  • Communication skills: you can independently write high-quality formal documents, and represent Rain in high-stakes meetings (e.g., with regulators, investors, partners, customers…).

  • Business and tech acumen: can work through complexity across different workstreams (e.g., pricing, tech, legal, compliance) identifying what matters in a context full of noise.

  • Project management experience: you have driven complex projects to completion, particularly when task owners don’t directly report to you.

  • Practicality and effectiveness: you get things done quickly despite challenges, and are able to deliver a high amount of output when required.

  • Intellectual curiosity: you are eager to go deep into technical topics, particularly when the response is not obvious.

  • Desire to travel: you are interested in spending significant time in person in the target markets to launch the product, hire a local team, and solve problems.

  • Location: you are based in New York or Madrid, or have a willingness to relocate.

  • Languages: you speak native / fluent English.

Bonus attributes:

  • Direct experience with regulatory approval processes, market expansion, post-merger integration, on either side of the table.

  • Experience in payments, card issuing, e-money or banking, whether at an operator, a regulator, an adviser or a network.

  • Having expanded a business into a new geography, including taking a product or a programme live in a new jurisdiction.

  • Knowledge of the payment / crypto regulatory landscape for payments and digital assets.

  • Familiarity with stablecoins and how onchain tech interacts with traditional payments.

  • Additional languages, particularly Spanish, Portuguese, Chinese or Arabic.

  • Experience building a function from scratch, including hiring the team who came after you.

Things that enable a fulfilling, healthy and happy experience at Rain:

Unlimited time off 🌴 Unlimited vacation can be daunting, so we require Rainmakers to take 10 days minimum for themselves.

Flexible working ☕ We support a flexible workplace – work from home, come into an office, or both. We want everyone to work in an environment where they're their most confident and productive selves. New Rainmakers receive a stipend to set up a comfortable home workspace.

Easy to access benefits 🧠 For US Rainmakers, we cover 95% of your health, dental, and vision plan costs and 90% for your dependents, plus a 100% company-subsidized life insurance plan.

Retirement goals💡 Plan for the future with confidence. We offer a 401(k) with a 4% company match.

Equity plan 📦 Every Rainmaker gets an equity option plan so we all benefit from our success.

Health and Wellness 📚 High performance begins from within. Rainmakers receive a monthly stipend to be used for eligible health and wellness spending like gym memberships/fitness classes, massages, acupuncture - whatever recharges you!

In-office meals 🍜 Rainmakers working from the office enjoy lunch and dinner on us, covered with a DoorDash credit.

Team summits ✨ Summits play an important role at Rain. Time together helps us build relationships and a common destiny. Expect team and company offsites, both domestic and international.

Chainlink is the industry-standard oracle platform bringing the capital markets onchain and powering the majority of decentralized finance (DeFi). The Chainlink stack provides the essential data, interoperability, compliance, and privacy standards needed to power advanced blockchain use cases for institutional tokenized assets, lending, payments, stablecoins, and more. Since inventing decentralized oracle networks, Chainlink has enabled tens of trillions in transaction value and now secures the vast majority of DeFi.

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe crypto will help reshape the future and contribute to greater individual freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions of customers access to crypto trading and decentralised applications. OKX is also trusted by institutions seeking secure access to crypto markets and is supported by its Proof of Reserves programme.

Across our global offices, we are united by three core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These values shape how we work and help us create a collaborative, rewarding and diverse environment for every OK-er.

About the Team

The Compliance function is responsible for promoting a strong compliance culture and supporting the safe, sustainable growth of OKX. We are a team of risk-minded problem solvers who advise the business on regulatory obligations, conduct expectations and enterprise risks.

OKX Europe Limited operates within a significant EU regulatory perimeter, including authorisation as a crypto-asset service provider under the Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation and as a payment institution in Malta.

About the Opportunity

As Deputy Head of Compliance for OKX Europe Limited, you will support the Head of Compliance in leading the entity’s Compliance function and maintaining an effective compliance framework across its crypto-asset and payment services.

You will oversee the day-to-day operation of key elements of the compliance programme, provide trusted advice to senior stakeholders and deputise for the Head of Compliance when required. You will help translate regulatory requirements into practical controls and ensure that compliance considerations are embedded in products, services and strategic decisions.

The position reports to the Head of Compliance, OKX Europe Limited, with appropriate access to local senior management, Board committees and relevant regional and global Compliance leaders.

What You’ll Be Doing

You will:

  • Leadership & Governance: Support the Head of Compliance in managing the function, people, and annual plan, and deputise at management and committee meetings when required.
  • Regulatory Advisory: Provide commercially aware advice to Product, Engineering, Operations, Legal, and Risk teams on EU/Maltese regulations, including MiCA, payment services, DORA, and consumer protection.
  • Framework & Product Reviews: Maintain a risk-based framework for crypto-asset and payment activities. Conduct compliance reviews of customer journeys, disclosures, complaints, conflicts of interest, safeguarding, outsourcing, and operational resilience.
  • Monitoring & Remediation: Run the Compliance Monitoring Programme (thematic reviews, control testing). Oversee risk assessments, escalate breaches, and drive sustainable remediation.
  • Regulatory Relations: Assist in managing the relationship with the MFSA and other authorities, coordinating supervisory meetings, information requests, and accurate regulatory notifications/returns.
  • Reporting: Prepare high-quality reports on key risks, trends, breaches, and monitoring findings for senior management, Boards, and committees.
  • Cross-Functional Defense: Partner closely with the MLRO and Financial Crime teams (maintaining clear boundaries between regulatory and financial crime duties), as well as Risk and Internal Audit.
  • Culture & Training: Coach the Compliance team, deliver targeted training to directors and staff, and champion a culture where regulatory obligations and customer interests guide business decisions.

What We Look For in You

  • Experience & Education: 5+ years of regulatory compliance experience in financial services, payments, fintech, or the crypto-asset sector, including a senior role. A bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) is required.
  • Subject Matter Expertise: Deep working knowledge of MiCA, the EU regulatory framework for crypto-asset service providers, and EU payment-services regulation.
  • Applied Compliance Skills: Practical experience designing and operating compliance frameworks, monitoring programmes, and risk assessments, as well as advising on tech-led product development and regulatory change.
  • Regulator Engagement & Fitness: Proven track record of engaging with financial regulators and responding to supervisory reviews or inspections. Must possess the professional standing to satisfy regulatory fitness and propriety expectations and obtain necessary approvals.
  • Leadership & Judgement: Strong people-management skills to set priorities and coach teams. Highly ethical and independent, with the sound judgement to constructively challenge senior stakeholders and take principled positions.
  • Communication & Global Collaboration: Professional fluency in English with the ability to explain complex regulatory matters clearly and pragmatically. Comfortable working across functions, jurisdictions, and time zones in a fast-paced environment.

Nice to Have

  • Previous experience within a regulated crypto-asset business, payment institution, electronic-money institution or digital bank.
  • Experience working in Malta or with the Malta Financial Services Authority.
  • Experience supporting or deputising for a regulated Head of Compliance or approved compliance officer.
  • Knowledge of EU regulatory requirements relating to safeguarding, stablecoins, outsourcing, operational resilience, consumer protection and cross-border passporting.
  • A relevant professional qualification from the International Compliance Association, ACAMS or an equivalent body.
  • A legal, accounting, risk-management or regulatory qualification.
  • Knowledge of and genuine enthusiasm for the crypto and digital-assets industry.

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive total compensation package.
  • Learning and development programmes and an education subsidy.
  • Team-building programmes and company events.
  • Wellness and meal allowances.
  • Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants.
  • Additional benefits that we would be pleased to discuss during the recruitment process.

OKX is committed to providing equal employment opportunities regardless of race, colour, genetic information, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, lawful alien status, national origin, age, marital status, non-job-related physical or mental disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Profile

descriptions.job-0nz3n0v:
Who we are  

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

You'll be joining the Finance Operational Excellence team, reporting to the Head of Finance Operational Excellence. We are finance transformation and AI experts working side-by-side with Finance, Product, and Engineering teams to redefine processes and build the finance organization of the future. This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys working across disciplines: part solution developer, part data architect, part workflow designer, and part coach. You’ll have room to shape how applied AI is built and scaled both from a technical and end-user perspective.

What you’ll do

You'll work side-by-side with Finance subject matter experts to understand how work gets done, identify the highest impact opportunities, and partner with domain teams to chart a transformation plan which balances future ambitions with rapid impact.  You'll work independently to automate manual processes, design and build agents and required data solutions using internal platforms, and enable Finance teams to maintain these solutions long-term. 

You’ll build with your partner teams, not simply deliver solutions to them. You’ll help colleagues move from a manual workflow, to a first AI-enabled win, to a reliable solution they can confidently operate and improve themselves. Success means the workflow stays transformed after the initial build, the team trusts the output, and the people closest to the process can own what comes next. 

You’ll favor learning through building. When possible, you’ll put a useful prototype in front of a Finance user, test it against a real deliverable, and improve it quickly rather than spend weeks describing a theoretical future state. When you encounter platform limitations—which you will—you’ll find creative, supportable approaches, collaborate with Engineering to scope and test custom tools, and escalate strategically when needed.

This role requires a blend of process automation, data operations, technical problem-solving, and stakeholder enablement. You'll spend your time building agents, optimizing data pipelines that feed them, creating knowledge layers that make them more accurate, and training Finance teams to use and maintain them. Success means Finance teams can independently run agents you've built while you provide light support and focus on the next automation opportunity.

Responsibilities

  • Embed with Finance teams to diagnose workflows, identify high-leverage opportunities, and translate business, data, and control requirements into practical AI and automation solutions.
  • Build and operationalize AI agents for Finance use cases, delivering end-to-end solutions from prototype through validation, monitoring, documentation, and handoff.
  • Write and optimize SQL for data extraction, transformation, calculation, and validation, ensuring Finance-facing outputs are accurate, explainable, and reliable.
  • Design reusable knowledge layers, evaluation methods, validation patterns, data-quality frameworks, and components that improve agent accuracy and accelerate future use cases.
  • Identify agentic limitations and new possibilities; determine when to use existing capabilities, develop an alternative approach, or partner with Engineering to scope and test custom tools and integrations, including tools using Model Context Protocol where appropriate.
  • Build alongside users, gather feedback through real deliverables, and iterate until the solution fits the workflow and earns user trust.
  • Enable long-term ownership through clear SOPs, runbooks, training, and self-service tooling; coach Finance teams to operate, maintain, and evolve what has been built.
  • Establish monitoring and observability for deployed agents, including metrics, alerting, and incident-response processes that support reliable operation.
  • Diagnose technical and data issues, resolve problems independently where possible, and collaborate with Engineering when solutions require deeper platform changes.
  • Measure adoption and impact, share lessons and wins, and turn successful implementations into standards, components, and playbooks for the broader Finance AI portfolio.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in data analytics, technical operations, business intelligence, automation, solutions delivery, or a related field.
  • Of which, 2+ years of experience in program management, working directly alongside business leaders to develop and execute process transformation programs
  • Hands-on experience building AI-enabled tools, agents, automations, or workflows that changed a real business process—not solely using AI as a conversational tool, 
  • Strong SQL proficiency, including experience writing complex queries using CTEs, window functions, and joins for data analysis, transformation, or pipeline logic.
  • A track record of independently scoping and delivering technical solutions for process improvement, demonstrating ownership from problem definition through adoption.
  • Strong analytical and investigative skills, including the ability to identify root causes, debug complex data problems, and resolve inconsistencies.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences and work effectively with domain experts and Engineering partners.
  • Experience teaching, coaching, enabling users, or transferring ownership of a solution through documentation, training, or self-service tools.
  • Working knowledge of development practices such as version control, testing, code review, and iterative delivery.
  • Experience using low-code tools, scripting, workflow automation, AI-assisted development, or custom integrations, paired with curiosity and the ability to learn evolving technologies.

You will also likely have (not required):

  • Domain experience in Finance Operations, Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), Accounting, Treasury, Tax, Payments, or other areas.
  • Familiarity with modern data tools and practices, such as Python, Databricks, ETL/ELT processes, data pipelines, and data-quality controls.
  • Experience with Model Context Protocol or another extensibility or integration framework.
  • Experience navigating financial systems and understanding how data flows through accounting, reporting, reconciliation, forecasting, or payments processes.
  • Experience with change management, organizational transformation, or large-scale enablement programs.
  • Experience building internal tools, templates, components, or playbooks that were adopted beyond the original team or use case.
  • Experience working in a high-growth technology company with rapidly evolving processes and tools.

Note on technical depth: This role involves working at the intersection of no-code AI tools and custom development. While software engineering expertise is not required, you should be comfortable applying technical concepts, collaborating closely with Engineering teams, and using AI-assisted development tools to extend platform capabilities when needed.

descriptions.job-1k984jz:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
 
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. 
 
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
 

About The Opportunity

We are looking for a Commercial Director to lead the next phase of OKX's growth in the Australian market.
This is a critical leadership role responsible for building and executing our commercial strategy to increase market presence, market share, trading volumes and revenue in Australia.
You will own the commercial growth agenda end-to-end - identifying where and how we win, translating market and customer insights into actionable strategies, developing new growth channels and strategic partnerships, and leading go-to-market initiatives that accelerate customer acquisition, engagement and trading activity.
As part of a global exchange operating in a fast-evolving industry, you will also play an important role in connecting our global capabilities with the needs and opportunities of the Australian market. You will work closely with local and global Product, Marketing, Growth, Operations, Legal & Compliance to ensure our commercial priorities translate into strong execution.
This is a builder role. We are looking for someone who can operate strategically while remaining execution-oriented - someone comfortable creating the commercial playbook, opening doors, testing new growth opportunities and building the capabilities and team required to scale them.
 

What You’ll Be Doing 

  • Own the Australian Commercial Strategy
    • Develop and execute the commercial strategy and roadmap for Australia, with clear accountability for market share, active customers, trading volume, revenue and brand recognition.
    • Identify the highest-impact growth opportunities across customer segments, products, channels and partnerships. Provide strong local market and customer insights.
    • Establish clear commercial priorities, KPIs and operating rhythms, continuously reviewing performance and reallocating resources toward the highest-impact opportunities.
  • Build the Growth Engine
    • Develop and execute strategies to accelerate customer acquisition, activation, engagement, retention and trading activity.
    • Identify opportunities to strengthen OKX's positioning and competitive differences in Australia.
    • Build scalable commercial models and growth channels rather than relying solely on short-term campaigns or individual relationships.
    • Work closely with Marketing, Product and Growth teams to improve customer journeys, propositions and conversion across the funnel.
  • Lead Go-to-Market Strategy & Execution
    • Own the commercial GTM strategy for major products, services and market initiatives in Australia.
    • Develop compelling local value propositions and determine the right customer segments, channels, partnerships and activation strategies.
    • Work cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, Compliance, Operations and Customer Support to translate GTM strategies into executable plans.
  • Develop Strategic Partnerships & Distribution
    • Identify, evaluate and structure strategic partnerships that can materially accelerate OKX's growth and market presence in Australia.
    • Explore new distribution channels and ecosystem opportunities that extend OKX's reach beyond traditional crypto acquisition channels.
  • Navigate a Global and Regulated Environment
    • Partner closely with Compliance, Legal and Risk teams to ensure commercial strategies and market initiatives are developed within applicable regulatory requirements.

What We Look For In You

  • 10+ years of experience across commercial strategy, business development, growth, partnerships or related roles, with meaningful leadership responsibility.
  • Strong track record of building or materially scaling a business, market or commercial function, ideally within crypto, fintech, trading, brokerage, financial services or another highly competitive digital and regulated business.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive measurable commercial outcomes including market share, active customers, trading volume, revenue and brand recognition.
  • Strong understanding of the Australian market, with the ability to identify local customer behaviours, competitive dynamics and growth opportunities.
  • Strong commercial judgement with the ability to move between strategy and hands-on execution.
  • Proven experience developing GTM strategies and translating them into successful market execution.
  • Demonstrated ability to originate, structure and negotiate strategic partnerships and commercial arrangements.
  • Strong analytical capabilities and comfort using data to diagnose performance, prioritise opportunities and make commercial decisions.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to influence senior stakeholders in a global matrix organisation.
  • Comfortable operating in an entrepreneurial, fast-moving environment where priorities evolve quickly and leaders are expected to build rather than simply manage.
  • Genuine interest in blockchain technology, digital assets and the evolution of financial markets.

Nice-To-Haves 

  • Experience at a crypto exchange or platform. Strong understanding of crypto trading products, customer segments and market structure.
  • Experience in trading, brokerage, derivatives, fintech or other transaction-driven businesses where commercial success is measured through customer trading activity and AUM.
  • Existing relationships across Australia's crypto, fintech, institutional, payments or broader financial-services ecosystem.
  • Experience working across global and cross-cultural teams, particularly within an international technology or financial-services organisation.
  • Familiarity with Australia's regulatory environment for digital assets and financial services.
  • Degree in Business, Finance, Economics or a related discipline.
     

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means building a sustainable commercial engine for OKX Australia.
You will have established a clear strategy for where and how OKX wins in the Australian market, built the team and partnerships required to execute against it, strengthened our local market presence, and created measurable improvement across market share, active customers, trading volume, revenue and brand recognition.
You will have created a sustainable, commercial operating model that combines the scale and capabilities of a global exchange with strong local market execution.

Perks & Benefits 

  • Competitive total compensation package
  • L&D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development
  • Various team building programs and company events
  • Wellness and meal allowances
  • Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants

About Magic Eden and Dicey
Magic Eden reached unicorn status in just 9 months after launch, one of the fastest in history. We built a category-defining NFT marketplace from scratch and proved we know how to move fast. Now we're doing it again. Dicey is our crypto casino and sportsbook platform, targeting the $180B+ iGaming and sports betting markets.

We're a small, fully remote team. We ship fast, we're hands-on with our data, and we're rebuilding how a growth team operates around AI from the ground up.

The role
Most of the iGaming industry competes on acquisition. Almost nobody has figured out personalized retention, knowing who a player is, what they need right now, and what would actually change their behavior this week. That's the problem you'll own.

This role focuses on the full post-signup journey: expanding our player segmentation framework, designing and running targeted offers and campaigns, and owning the P&L lever that comes with it. It's explicitly AI-native. You'll build workflows, agents, and pipelines to run lifecycle campaigns that would have taken a whole team two years ago. Half the job is identifying the right problem. The other half is running the experiments to find the answer.

What you'll do

  • Own retention and monetization as a growth loop. Set the targets, find the leverage, and drive the numbers for everything that happens after a player signs up

  • Own the player segmentation framework. Today it's value and risk. You decide how it evolves, what signals feed it, and how the rest of the company uses it

  • Build the AI-native growth stack. Analysis, agents, and automated pipelines that surface segments, generate offer candidates, and run campaigns with minimal manual work

  • Design and ship targeted offers for specific segments and moments: reload bonuses, lossback, wager bounties, challenges, win-back sequences. Size them, spec them, ship them, measure them

  • Spend real time in our data warehouse and on-chain data finding patterns and turn them into campaigns before anyone else does

  • Expand the signals we have on players: on-chain activity, status-match programs, social account linking, and whatever else you can think of

  • Run the campaigns. Email, in-app, Telegram, whatever the channel. You're hands-on with it, with AI doing the heavy lifting

  • Partner with engineering and design to ship the product surfaces that make all of this repeatable

What we're looking for

  • Strong intuition for player psychology and incentive design. Experience in gambling, gaming, fintech, or consumer marketplaces helps. Genuine curiosity about why people behave the way they do is required

  • Deeply analytical. You can go from a vague question to a clean cohort cut yourself, without waiting on a data scientist

  • AI-native by default. You already use AI to write queries, build analyses, and automate your own work and you want to push that much further

  • High output with good judgment. You generate a lot of ideas and know which ones are worth testing first

  • Bias to do it yourself. You're comfortable sending the email, running the query, and writing the spec, not just briefing others

  • Comfortable with ambiguity. There's no playbook here, you'll be building it

Backgrounds that tend to fit

  • Growth PM at a data-heavy consumer company

  • MBB consultant who wants to move into product and own outcomes, not just advise on them

  • Product Minded Data scientist or analyst who wants to ship, not just report

Why this is interesting

  • Competitive, top-of-market compensation

  • You're defining what a growth PM looks like in an AI-native company, there's no inherited playbook

  • Personalised retention is where the industry is going and we're building it early

  • Real ownership: a segmentation framework, a product surface, and a P&L lever, with a direct line to the founding team
